title: Sparkly ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='scoop' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd1e6'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ff9ec7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8709f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cone' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f2c078'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c98a3e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- cone body -->
  <polygon points='38,56 62,56 52,94 48,94' fill='url(#cone)'/>
  <!-- cone crosshatch lines -->
  <line x1='40' y1='62' x2='58' y2='62' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='70' x2='56' y2='70' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='78' x2='54' y2='78' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='86' x2='52' y2='86' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='57' x2='49' y2='93' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='57' x2='51' y2='93' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='57' x2='50' y2='93' stroke='#a86c28' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- scoop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='20' fill='url(#scoop)'/>
  <!-- scoop shading/highlight edge -->
  <path d='M32,42 A20,20 0 0 1 50,20' stroke='#ffb9d8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- drips over cone -->
  <path d='M38,56 q-2,7 3,7 q5,0 3,-6' fill='#ff9ec7'/>
  <path d='M57,56 q4,6 -1,8 q-5,1 -4,-7' fill='#ff9ec7'/>

  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='5' fill='#e0224a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='15.5' r='1.6' fill='#ff8fa5'/>
  <path d='M50,12 q3,-6 8,-6' stroke='#4ecb71' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7b0'>
    <path d='M22,26 l1.6,4.2 4.2,1.6 -4.2,1.6 -1.6,4.2 -1.6,-4.2 -4.2,-1.6 4.2,-1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M80,34 l1.2,3.2 3.2,1.2 -3.2,1.2 -1.2,3.2 -1.2,-3.2 -3.2,-1.2 3.2,-1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M76,16 l1,2.6 2.6,1 -2.6,1 -1,2.6 -1,-2.6 -2.6,-1 2.6,-1 z'/>
    <path d='M25,68 l1,2.6 2.6,1 -2.6,1 -1,2.6 -1,-2.6 -2.6,-1 2.6,-1 z'/>
    <path d='M72,66 l1.3,3.4 3.4,1.3 -3.4,1.3 -1.3,3.4 -1.3,-3.4 -3.4,-1.3 3.4,-1.3 z'/>
    <path d='M84,52 l0.9,2.3 2.3,0.9 -2.3,0.9 -0.9,2.3 -0.9,-2.3 -2.3,-0.9 2.3,-0.9 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
